review_comments.body: Can we assert span Id is not injected when MDC is disabled?

comments.body:
- "What if this line throws?": the MDC cleanup now runs in a `finally`, so `attemptScopes.close(key)` throwing can no longer leave a stale spanId in the MDC.
- "assert span Id is not injected when MDC is disabled": added `userFunction_withMdcDisabled_doesNotInjectSpanId`.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
@pcbeingused333 Thank you for your contribution. Approved.
